defs.def: a problem, worry, difficulty, etc. or a situation causing this 问题；忧虑；困难；苦恼

ex.s: How many kinds of wildflowers can be seen from your front door If your awareness is as sharp as it could be, you'll have no trouble answering these questions．
ex.t: 从你家门前能看到多少种野花？如果你的感知力足够敏锐，回答这些问题对你来说不成问题。

ex.s: On the fourth or fifth night, we had trouble finding a hotel with a vacancy.
ex.t: 在第四或第五个晚上，我们很难找到有空房的旅馆。

ex.s: “Let's look directly into the issue of collapse,” they say, “and deal with the terrible possibilities of what we see there to make the best of a troubling future.”
ex.t: “让我们直面崩溃这一问题，”他们说，“并应对我们在那里看到的那些可怕的可能性，以便在这令人不安的未来中做到最好。”

ex.s: One of the questions are：Who will you go in times of trouble?
ex.t: 其中一个问题是：遇到困难时你会去找谁？

ex.s: Social Comparisons Can Get Us into Emotional Trouble
ex.t: 社会比较会让我们陷入情感困境。

ex.s: In my opinion, where in trouble, we should seek help from those we trust mostly.
ex.t: 在我看来，遇到困难时，我们应该向我们最信任的人寻求帮助。

defs.def: illness or pain 疾病；疼痛
something that is wrong with a machine, vehicle, etc. （机器、车辆等的）故障
a situation that is difficult or dangerous; a situation in which you can be criticized or punished 困境；险境；可能受到批评（或处罚）的情形

ex.s: The solution to the mystery of the monarch’s amazing ability comes at a time when it is in serious trouble.
ex.t: 对帝王蝶惊人能力之谜的解答，出现在它陷入严重困境之时。

ex.s: Ryan had trouble believing the words which were spoken by his teacher...
ex.t: 瑞安不相信老师说的话

defs.def: an angry or violent situation 纷争；动乱；骚乱
extra effort or work 额外努力（或工作）；烦扰；打扰；麻烦

ex.s: Second, if other factors such as technology remain constant, economic growth and material expectations will fall well below recent standards and this could invite trouble.
ex.t: 其次，如果技术等其他因素保持不变，经济增长和物质期望将远低于近期标准，这可能引发麻烦。

ex.s: He never got into trouble, though sometimes he wanted to do risky things.
ex.t: 他从未惹上麻烦，尽管有时他想做一些冒险的事。

ex.s: The things we learn in maturity seldom involve information and skills． We learn to bear with the things we can't change． We learn to avoid self﹣pity． We learn that however much we try to please， some people are never going to love us﹣an idea that troubles at first but is eventually relaxing．
ex.t: 我们在成熟时学到的东西很少涉及信息和技能。我们学会忍受无法改变的事。我们学会避免自怜。我们学到，无论多么努力取悦，有些人永远不会爱我们——这个想法起初令人困扰，但最终令人释然。

ex.s: These lights, known as adaptive signals, have led to significant declines in both the trouble and cost of travels between work and home.
ex.t: 这些被称为自适应信号的灯，使上下班通勤的麻烦和成本都显著下降。

ex.s: If people remove food and attractants from their yards and campsites, grizzlies will typically pass by without trouble.
ex.t: 如果人们把食物和引诱物从自家院子和营地清除，灰熊通常会顺利通过而不惹麻烦。

ex.s: Social comparisons do, of course, often get us into emotional trouble.
ex.t: 当然，社会比较确实经常使我们陷入感情麻烦。

ex.s: But the next time you find yourself among strangers, consider that small talk is worth the trouble.
ex.t: 但下次你发现自己和陌生人在一起时，考虑一下闲聊是值得麻烦的。

ex.s: His brother was in trouble.
ex.t: 他的弟弟遇上了麻烦。

ex.s: Ben Dear Ben, There is an old American saying, “Loose lips sink ships.” This means that if you speak too much about something, especially to people who you don’t know so well, it’ll cause all kinds of trouble.
ex.t: 本·亲爱的本(Ben Dear Ben ) , 有一句古老的美国谚语 : “ 唇沉船 ” 。 这意味着如果你对某件事说得太多，特别是对那些你不了解的人来说，那会引发各种麻烦。

defs.def: the time of political and social problems in Northern Ireland, especially after 1968, when there was violence between Catholics and Protestants about whether Northern Ireland should remain part of the UK 动乱时期（尤指 1968 年后，天主教徒和新教徒之间就北爱尔兰是否应继续附属于英国而引发的暴力冲突）
to make sb worried or upset 使忧虑；使烦恼；使苦恼

ex.s: Humor also transports your mind away from your daily troubles.
ex.t: 幽默还能让你的思绪从日常烦恼中转移开来。

ex.s: Why does Bill look troubled?
ex.t: 比尔为什么看起来忧虑？

ex.t: 比尔为什么看起来忧虑？

ex.t: 比尔为什么看起来忧虑？

ex.t: 回到家后，埃勒斯为那只____45____的小狗感到不安。

defs.def: to disturb sb because you want to ask them sth 常用于客气的请求
to make an effort to do sth 通常用于否定句
to cause pain 健康问题

ex.s: Ryan had trouble believing the words spoken by his teacher ...
ex.t: 瑞安很难相信老师说的话...
